source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists using broad DIMM filter, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 56.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents one aggregate title sensor, truncates OOB-only evidence and cannot prove the power-specific DIMM population.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires exact power membership, socket/channel/zone/rail map and exclusion of non-power DIMM sensors.

old_problem: DIMM is a hardware association rather than a sensor type, so the broad source filter may return temperature, voltage, presence or power records. The source gives no authoritative CPU_DIMM power membership, socket/channel/DIMM-zone/rail mapping, units, sampling semantics or load-dependent limits, and criteria jump from 2 to 56.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by retaining the broad inventory for discovery but grading only the approved power-type members. ED-03 permits the exact CPU/socket/channel/DIMM-zone/rail bindings and memory population as Project Configuration; ED-13 governs absent members and ED-15 requires approved load-dependent limits. Non-power DIMM records remain evidence but cannot substitute for power coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2030, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2031 / Wistron-BMC-01050-V002 / 7b76556bdd0ea222.

Complete raw IB/OOB lists retain every DIMM match, after which the signed sensor-type/membership map selects CPU_DIMM power members and explicitly labels excluded temperature/voltage/presence records.
Each accepted power member is bound to CPU socket, memory channel, DIMM zone and rail/aggregation; memory population, workload, CPU power limit and thermal context are aligned with sampling cadence.
A synthetic item-title sensor cannot prove member completeness and unrelated DIMM telemetry cannot fill a missing power record.
Criteria 1, 2 and 56 remain as written; no criteria 3-55 are fabricated.
No ipmitool, memory/power query, authentication, Web capture, workload/memory/power-policy change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Typed CPU/DIMM power-population and topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved CPU_DIMM power member is correctly typed and mapped to CPU socket, memory channel, DIMM zone and rail, with fresh SPEC-consistent fields across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web under aligned memory population and load.
required_package: SUT/BMC/BIOS/CPU/memory/firmware identity and installed DIMM population
Approved CPU_DIMM power-sensor membership plus explicit non-power DIMM exclusion/classification map
Approved units/scaling/instantaneous-or-average cadence, load-dependent ranges/thresholds/freshness and channel-availability rules
Aligned workload/CPU power-limit/thermal context, ipmitool, protected access, platform/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze installed memory, CPU power policy and workload context. Preserve logs and capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before broad DIMM filtering. Classify every match by sensor type using the signed map, exact-match each approved power member, capture all corresponding Web rows, and compare topology, units/scaling/value/state/threshold/freshness at aligned timestamps. Do not grade unrelated DIMM sensors as power, target the item title, truncate, alter workload/memory/power policy, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved CPU_DIMM power member appears exactly once at the correct socket/channel/zone/rail with fresh SPEC-valid, mutually consistent data in all supported views; all broad-filter exclusions are explained and no power/memory/thermal fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete approved power membership, topology/type classification and full supported-view evidence meeting approved load-dependent rules. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale power member, wrong sensor type/topology/scaling, mismatch, exceeded limit or new power/memory/thermal fault. Missing membership/map/limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no DIMM handling, memory configuration, workload, CPU power-policy, firmware or threshold changes.
Retain full inventories and classification rationale; protect credentials.
Stop on identity/type ambiguity, memory error, missing/stale telemetry, power alarm or thermal fault.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first installed-population and operating context.
expected_evidence: Approved power membership and classification of every broad DIMM match
Socket/channel/DIMM-zone/rail/aggregation five-view map and versioned rules
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web rows and per-power-member comparison with workload/power-limit/thermal context
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, type/topology ambiguity, access failure, missing/mismatched telemetry, memory error or power/thermal alarm, stop and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reseat memory, change policy, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact socket/channel/zone/rail/member.

source_conflict.reason: Complete broad discovery plus an authoritative sensor-type/membership map resolves the power-specific scope without hiding other DIMM matches; Project topology and limits provide interpretation.

blocked.reason: Passive discovery, type separation, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; membership/topology/limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Installed DIMM population, approved CPU_DIMM power membership/type exclusions, socket/channel/zone/rail map, sampling/scaling/limits and aligned operating context.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TYPED CPU_DIMM POWER MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, MEMORY/POWER QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, WORKLOAD/MEMORY/POWER-POLICY CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
